integrity: Proof derives exact Gaussian fourth-moment recursion and full SPD symmetrization; numerical experiments only corroborate finite checks. Independent scientific audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Real isotropic quadratic, fresh independent Gaussian probes, noiseless symmetric two-point evaluations, known interval of squared subspace alignment, fixed positive-definite covariance and stepsize. The exact minimax condition is for Euclidean second moments and does not imply nonlinear optimization rates, unique full-cone covariance, or computational efficiency.
title: A sharp alignment threshold for minimax anisotropic Gaussian finite-difference probes
